summary: feat(settings): compose the passkey wrap envelope create and unwrap
description:
Because:
- Passwordless Sync needs a client that can seal kB to a passkey and
  recover it from the stored envelope.

This commit:
- Adds createWrapEnvelope and openWrapEnvelope over the HPKE and AES-GCM
  layers.
- Binds uid and credentialId into the envelope context.
- Keeps the crypto layers and context construction module-local.

Closes #FXA-13147
